Quickship Electronics via eBay is taking 10% off eligible new and open-box electronics with promo code "NICEFIND10", capped at $150 per use and good for up to 10 uses through December 31. The open-box listings include LG, Samsung, and ASUS monitors, Apple Watch and AirPods models, and Samsung Galaxy tablets and watches, all with free shipping. Shop Now at eBay

Features
  • 10% off eligible new and open-box electronics
  • Discount capped at $150 per use
  • Up to 10 coupon uses per eBay account
  • Coupon valid through 11:59 PM PT on December 31, 2026
  • Covers monitors, smartwatches, tablets, earbuds, & Apple and Samsung devices
  • Free shipping on the listed items
